values.title: Christian Faith & Biblical Integrity
values.text: We are guided by Christian faith and biblical principles in our ministry, relationships and service to communities.

values.title: Compassion & Servant Leadership
values.text: We serve with humility, compassion and a commitment to putting people and communities at the heart of what we do.

values.title: Human Dignity & Respect
values.text: We recognise the inherent dignity and worth of every person and treat all people with respect, fairness and care.

values.title: Accountability & Transparency
values.text: We are committed to responsible stewardship, openness and accountability to the communities, partners and supporters we serve.

values.title: Partnership & Collaboration
values.text: We believe sustainable transformation is achieved through strong partnerships and collective action.

values.title: Community Participation
values.text: We involve communities in identifying their needs, developing solutions and taking ownership of sustainable change.

pillars.label: Community-Led
pillars.short: Communities identify priorities and shape solutions.
pillars.long: We listen to communities and involve them in identifying priorities and developing solutions.

pillars.label: Christ-Centred
pillars.short: Faith moves us to serve with humility and love.
pillars.long: Our Christian faith motivates us to serve with compassion, humility, integrity and love.

pillars.label: Holistic
pillars.short: Spiritual, social, emotional and economic needs together.
pillars.long: We address spiritual, social, educational, emotional, economic and physical needs together.

pillars.label: Partnership-Based
pillars.short: Local and international partners, shared resources.
pillars.long: We collaborate with local and international partners to maximise knowledge, resources and impact.

pillars.label: Sustainable
pillars.short: Local capacity and ownership that lasts.
pillars.long: We strengthen local capacity and ownership so that communities can sustain positive change.

pillars.label: Inclusive
pillars.short: Women, girls, youth and the vulnerable take part.
pillars.long: We ensure that women, girls, children, youth and vulnerable groups have opportunities to participate and benefit.
